business_problem: After a merger, Wintershall Dea needed a scalable way to connect data, skills, and AI use cases across the larger organization because existing projects were isolated, difficult to scale, and not supported by a common delivery platform or operating model.
solution_summary: Wintershall Dea partnered with IBM Consulting to build an AI-at-scale capability that combined platform architecture, operating-model design, and employee enablement. IBM adapted its AI@Scale methodology to the company’s existing Microsoft Azure data platform and used assessments to define a roadmap for a new center of competence, citizen-data-science community, and repeatable MLOps-based architecture. IBM then helped Wintershall Dea provision the technical environment, customize templates, run enablement sessions, and apply IBM Garage methods so business units could qualify and develop both small “firefly” projects and larger enterprise use cases. That framework supported solutions such as PDF extraction workflows that automate manual engineering tasks and well-integrity models that analyze live subsea sensor data for anomaly detection. Instead of treating AI as a sequence of pilots, Wintershall Dea created a structured platform for moving proofs of concept into production and for scaling successful ideas across operations, engineering, geoscience, and business functions.

solution_components.name: IBM Consulting
solution_components.role: Co-developed Wintershall Dea’s AI center of competence, roadmap, and deployment approach across technical and organizational dimensions.

solution_components.name: IBM AI@Scale
solution_components.role: Provided the methodology, assessments, templates, and scaling patterns used to move AI ideas into production.

solution_components.name: IBM Garage
solution_components.role: Guided the qualification and development of business use cases into full AI solutions.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Azure
solution_components.role: Hosts the component-based technical foundation and MLOps environment used for Wintershall Dea’s AI work.

data_flow: Business and operational data from across Wintershall Dea feeds into the Azure-based AI platform, teams use AI@Scale templates and MLOps workflows to develop and test solutions, and resulting models are pushed into business-unit or production environments such as PDF extraction and live well-sensor monitoring.
business_outcome: Wintershall Dea established a scalable AI operating model, identified dozens of viable use cases, trained more than 100 employees, automated document extraction work, and launched well-integrity AI into production with a stronger citizen-data-science community behind it.
